segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin generally describe the product as hydrating and non-greasy, calling it dry-skin friendly, though one reviewer reports it dried her skin out badly and caused small bumps.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers report no breakouts or irritation and call it gentle, but several others describe allergic-type reactions, redness, swelling, or breakouts from the same product.
segments.oily: The reviewer who identifies as oily-skinned reports a natural finish with no irritation or breakouts, while another with a T-zone oiliness issue found it turned shiny within hours.
segments.combination: A combination-skin reviewer found her T-zone became oily and shiny within a couple of hours and advises oily/combo skin to skip it, while another with combination and sensitive skin reports no breakouts at all.
segments.normal: Reviewers describing normal to dry skin report a light, non-oily feel and effective hydration.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s to 60s describe it as well suited to mature skin, citing a natural glow, hydration, and anti-aging ingredients without heaviness.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for anti-aging cite the SPF, niacinamide, and hyaluronic acid, reporting it sinks in without settling into fine lines and fits into an anti-aging routine.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry or very dry skin, report it hydrates without greasiness; however, at least two describe it drying their skin out badly, in one case with dry splotches and bumps.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report new redness, swelling, or a burning/tingling reaction after use, including one describing a chemical-burn-like sensation; one reviewer who hoped it would cover existing redness found it did not.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers describe reactions consistent with irritation or allergy — itching, a rash-like breakout, swollen eyes — with one attributing it to the silicones and oils in the formula on acne-prone skin.
concerns.spots: A small number of reviewers mention hyperpigmentation or dark spots: one credits the niacinamide with evening her skin tone over time and another says it evens pink undertones and sun damage, while one notes it does not cover dark spots.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several who identify as acne-prone or sensitive, report no new breakouts; a smaller number describe breakouts or bumps, with one linking this to the silicone content.
concerns.oiliness: An oily-skinned reviewer reports a natural, non-greasy finish, while a combination-skin reviewer says her T-zone turned oily and shiny within a couple of hours and advises oily or combination skin to skip it.

extraits.titre: Be aware of the Silicones in this product if you are Acne Prone
extraits.texte: I initially bought this product because I was very much liking the Laura Mercier oil free tinted moisturizer, but wasn’t loving the price. This product kept popping up in my Amazon as more hydrating, better ingredients, etc. After using it for two days, my skin broke out like this, because as I researched further, this product does have silicones in it, and some oils that can irritate acne prone skin as well as even cause some fungal acne. I have super dry and sensitive skin and this product did not do me any favors. Currently on a week of healing this breakout because of how intense it was, but still have a long way to go. If you have clear skin that’s not sensitive, perfect for you. But my acne sensitive skin girls, maybe steer clear of this one.

extraits.titre: Another over hyped product & bad packaging
extraits.texte: I wasn't expecting a lot of coverage but there is absolutely no tint to this product. It's a little oily/shiny when applying but it does dry down a little bit. But within a couple of hours, my t-zone was a shiny oily mess. It may be fine for someone with flawless skin or that's dry/normal. But if you're looking for something to even out your skin a little and/or you have oily/combo skin skip it, it's just another over-hyped product. UPDATE: Originally rated 3 stars but now bumping it down to 2 star after taking it on a trip. When I arrived the package was broken and a total mess. It was not in a checked bag where it was being thrown around, I carried it on the plane. It can still be used with just the inner tube/container and without the lid but now it's not portable. The one good thing I can say is that I used it as my main face sunscreen for 6 days in the Caribbean and it did provide good protection and I did not get burned. Also, there is no white cast you can get with some sunscreens. But with everything else bad about it I will not repurchase it.

extraits.titre: Love the product hate the packaging
extraits.texte: Love this product. I have very sensitive skin and this does not break me out at all. However the packaging is terrible and how it is shipped. Received with makeup leaking around plastic seal and decided to clean it up and use it anyway. Second day of use I pushed down on the pump and the entire bottom broke off from the actual bottle that is inside. I’m guessing it must of been cracked in shipping and I never noticed until now. You know a product is good when I still am not going to return is because that’s how much I love the product on my skin and it’s still usable just it’s now in its less attractive packaging.

extraits.titre: Great for oily skin, brown girl friendly!
extraits.texte: I love this tinted sunscreen! I wish I had tried it sooner. While I usually prefer mineral sunscreens, I occasionally make an exception and this is one of them. I know a lot of other people love this but I was skeptical about the color match. Brown girls don’t always get this lucky. Turns out, it blends in beautifully into my skin. This does not have any cast on me at all. The coverage is very sheer and barely there, very natural; so it’s not covering up any imperfections. The texture is like a lightweight moisturizer, not runny, and it spreads very easily. Reapplication is a breeze. This is not a sweat resistant formula so it’s not for beach days. However, it’s a great option for daily wear. I have oily skin and this has a natural finish. It’s such an elegant formula. No irritation, no breakouts, and it doesn’t burn my eyes. It feels moisturizing but not heavy. The bottle arrived with a tamper proof seal. And the pump works great, no issues. I think the price is fine for such a nice formula and packaging. But if you can get it on sale, don’t hesitate! I also love these tinted sunscreens: Neutrogena Mineral UV Tint in Medium Deep, Elta MD UV Daily Tinted, Colorscience Flex in Tan (has more coverage to even out skin tone). Some of my foundation colors in case it helps you determine if this tint works for you: Armani 7.8, ELDW Honey Bronze, KVD 063, MUFE 3N42, Haus Labs 330, Dior 4N, Nars Aruba.

I have very pale and dry skin, the tint is certifiably completely sheer and very dry skin friendly. Which is amazing after fighting white cast in the previous, I'd say five - ten different daily spf products. I'm probably sticking to this one long term. It sinks in leaving nothing but dewy ultra-smooth skin. I've attached three pictures. One of how it pumps out (doesn't run all over the place) another of a single circular motion showing its consistency when it sits on the skin, and the final one of my still very fair skin and the subtle glow left behind after rubbing it in from my wrist line to about half an inch before the pic cuts off I've already reccomended this to multiple friends. Will likely update when I finish this bottle.

extraits.titre: Everything I need in one product!
extraits.texte: I love makeup, but now that I’m 51, I’m embracing a lighter and more natural routine for everyday wear. I’ve been using this Anti-Aging Tinted Moisturizer, and I absolutely love it! It’s everything I need in one product, light coverage that evens out my skin tone, SPF for daily sun protection, and a formula that leaves my face feeling fresh and hydrated. It doesn’t feel heavy, and it gives me a healthy, radiant glow. Perfect for mature skin and anyone looking to simplify their makeup routine without sacrificing results! Love it!! 💫

extraits.titre: Great for sensitive skin and evening skin tone
extraits.texte: I originally bought this as an affordable alternative to my Revision Intellishade and it did not disappoint!! It evens my skin tone (pink undertones and hyperpigmentation/sun damage). I have very sensitive skin and this has been wonderful for that. I love that it has broad spectrum sun protection at nearly 50 spf. A little goes a long way. It does not leave a white cast on your skin and it absorbs beautifully leaving a healthy glow. I would definitely recommend this tinted moisturizer.
